pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: crates/table-core/src/exposure_tests.rs:296 The test the_signed_bytes_are_domain_separated_and_commit_every_field claims every field of the owner-signed WalletEnvelope is committed, but its hand list of 5 mutations skips `currency` (the struct has 6 fields), so a change that dropped currency from the signed bytes would stay green under a name that says it is pinned.

techniques.evidence: crates/table-core/src/exposure_tests.rs:296 A hand-written list under an 'every field' claim covers 5 of the 6 WalletEnvelope fields (version, max_out_day, max_held, max_deals_day, expires), and the omitted one is currency. The same crate does the right thing elsewhere: agent_tests.rs:318 derives RefusalCode/Playbook ALL from serde's variant list with a floor, and exposure_tests.rs:353 uses an exhaustive match.

crates/table-core/src/checks.rs:74 The name claims every field of ApprovalCheck is committed, but the body only varies status, text, detail and order, while `id` stays fixed at ApprovalCheckId::Amount in line(). The name claims a stronger guard than the assertions make.
